question: Does an independent HES observation of enemy military presence contain forward predictive information about later enemy-initiated activity beyond recent incident history?
theory_link: Tests an observable implication of the confirmed synthetic reproduction/access mechanism after the event-only cross-case analogue failed. It does not identify M_star or a recruitment coefficient.

sources.predictor: HES70 enemy military presence submodel, standardized auxiliary construct hes_enemy_military_presence_submodel
sources.outcome: cleaned MACV/NARA ground-combat archival extract, standardized events actor_a == 'Enemy'
sources.source_independence: HES observation system is distinct from the ground-combat incident extract
documentation: NARA HES 1969-1973 Command Manual: enemy military presence derives from observations of enemy forces, base areas, staging areas, supply caches, defensive works, etc.
NARA/CIA documentation establishes ordered HES category designators with A representing better GVN/security conditions than later letters; HES is not treated here as direct territorial control.

measurement_operator.name: ordinal_enemy_presence_burden
measurement_operator.formula: (count_C + count_D + count_E + count_V) / (count_A + count_B + count_C + count_D + count_E + count_V)
measurement_operator.why_this_form: Uses only the documented ordering and a coarse upper/lower partition; it does not assume equal interval spacing among letter grades.
measurement_operator.direction: larger = worse HES enemy-presence environment from the GVN perspective

prediction_design.outcome: log(1 + enemy-initiated event count during the next 3 calendar months)
baseline_features: log(1 + focal-province enemy events in preceding 3 months)
log(1 + national enemy events in preceding 3 months)
prediction_design.estimator: ordinary least squares / sklearn LinearRegression; no regularization or hyperparameter selection

secondary: heldout top-vs-bottom presence-burden quartile future activity ratio
sensitivity excluding province fixed effects (descriptive only)
guards: Do not interpret a pass as proof of recruitment, membership, or territorial control.
Do not alter HES ordinal cutpoints after observing the holdout result.
Direct NARA row/layout parity remains a provenance limitation of the cleaned HES extract and must stay in claim language.
